title: Partner orders to the order system: process validation
process: The process: the partner places an order  >  the platform hands it to the order system  >  the warehouse picks it  >  the partner is told it shipped.
reference: Technical plan for the tester (sample files, queries): <file name>

scenarios.title: GOOD: an order follows the whole process, from the partner to shipped

steps.step: The partner places an order for a test product
steps.expected: The order is visible at the partner. Note the order number.

steps.step: The order is handed to the order system automatically
steps.expected: One order exists in the order system within 10 minutes. Customer, product and amount are those of the partner's order.

steps.step: The warehouse picks and ships the order
steps.expected: The normal warehouse process works as before.

steps.step: The partner receives the shipping message
steps.expected: The partner shows the order as shipped.

scenarios.title: BAD: the process is interrupted by a message that cannot be read

steps.step: A message arrives that is not an order
steps.expected: The platform still answers 'accepted' so the sender is not blocked. No order is created.

steps.step: The team is warned and finds the message
steps.expected: A warning mail arrived. The message is kept aside with the reason and its content unchanged.

scenarios.title: IN BETWEEN: orders that need no action

steps.step: The partner sends an order for a product we do not handle
steps.expected: Accepted and skipped. No order, nothing kept aside, and the skip is counted.
